hero_sub: Choose your tree. We handle the pickup, delivery, setup, and cleanup, then come back for it when the season's over.
about_headline: Christmas Should Feel Magical, Not Like a Chore.
about_text: Palmetto Christmas Co. was built by Hank and Jacob, two Charleston locals who wanted to take the hassle out of one of the best parts of the season. No tying a tree to the roof of your car, no needles through the house, no wrestling with a stand. We handle the work so you can just enjoy Christmas.
cta_sub: Get a free, no-pressure quote in minutes. We'll give you an upfront price. No surprises.
